picks.editorial_note: MIT's Regina Barzilay and James Collins won the 2026 Pritzker Prize for AI in Science Research Excellence, the field's top honor, for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery that has already yielded new drug candidates.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: A $39.5 million ARPA-H-funded consortium spanning Boston University, Philips, Johns Hopkins, and Weill Cornell will develop AI-enabled robotic catheter technology for remote stroke intervention, a major federal bet on AI-driven medical robotics.
picks.title: Brink Bites: Robotic Stroke Surgery, Curbing Junk Food Sales, and American Attitudes On Data Center Construction

picks.editorial_note: Nebraska will lead cybersecurity for FabAID, a five-year, $24.5 million NSF national infrastructure project to secure AI-driven scientific computing across institutions.
picks.title: University to lead cybersecurity for national Fabric for AI-Driven Science project

picks.editorial_note: Michigan State's trustees approved a $30 million capital request for TEMPEST, a new center fusing physics, computation, and AI for turbulence research — a significant state-backed investment in AI-enabled science infrastructure.
picks.title: MSU trustees receive presentation on new turbulence research center, approve state capital outlay request

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC signed a strategic framework agreement anchored by HSBC's new AI & Emerging Technology Institute, deepening a near-decade academic-financial industry partnership around AI commercialization.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: A Georgetown economist's analysis of SpaceX and Anthropic's massive equity giveaways — including Anthropic's pledge of up to $100 billion in shares — highlights unprecedented wealth distribution tied to AI company valuations, with major policy and economic implications.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills from purely self-generated synthetic data rather than real-world data, a notable step toward reducing AI's dependence on scraped training data.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It

picks.editorial_note: ASU's $3.2 million NIH-funded project uses deep learning on retinal images plus blood biomarkers to screen for preclinical Alzheimer's disease, a potentially low-cost, scalable early-detection approach.
picks.title: What the eye may reveal about Alzheimer’s

picks.editorial_note: RPI's Quest2Dx model improves early-stage Parkinson's screening accuracy using health questionnaires, offering a low-cost diagnostic tool with real clinical potential.
picks.title: RPI Team Builds AI Model for More Effective Early Parkinson’s Screening

picks.editorial_note: Weill Cornell's LabARIA agentic AI framework aims to catch clinical lab errors before they reach patients, an applied AI safety tool with direct patient-care impact.
picks.title: AI System May Help Clinical Labs Spot Problems Before They Affect Patients
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University
